name: client-wallet-payment-refund-wlt-boundary
executionConcern: client wallet, ledger, payment and refund financial boundary
objective: Keep every customer-visible balance, ledger, payment eligibility/status and refund consequence WLT-owned, actor/context isolated and consumed through governed DSH/WLT boundaries without parallel financial truth.
truthOwner: WLT is sole financial truth owner; DSH may proxy/hold operational references but cannot mutate wallet or ledger truth.

tasks.objective: Close client financial ownership and isolation boundaries
tasks.currentProblem: MySpace uses WLT shared ActorWalletPanel and Product Truth requires own actor/operator-context-bound reads, yet live backend/ledger authorization, payment/refund idempotency and stale financial display are not proven by static composition.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace client wallet/ledger/payment/refund flows through WLT shared frontend, DSH BFF, WLT contracts/backend/database; correct scope, correlation, idempotency and readback while deleting any proven local balance derivation.
tasks.targetState: Client sees only own WLT balances/ledger/payment/refund truth; unavailable finance fails closed; DSH stores no independent balance/ledger truth and money-moving actions use WLT-owned commands.
tasks.action: Correct WLT owner/database invariants first, DSH proxy boundaries second and client presentation last; preserve financial audit lineage.
mustNotChange: Do not accept arbitrary actor/operator context from app-client.
Do not derive wallet balance from DSH/order/settlement summaries.
Do not append ledger or mutate balance in DSH/frontend.
Do not expose finance.read as money-moving permission.
acceptanceCriteria: Wallet and ledger values equal WLT readback with explicit unavailable/error states.
Payment/refund retries preserve one financial effect and correlated operational reference.
No DSH/frontend balance mutation path is introduced.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore a parallel truth source.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U005 implementation commit after owner correction, directly affected consumer migration, cleanup and all linked checks.
